result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position: it adds a mutual cap equal to the greater of trailing-12-month amounts and USD 1,000,000, while excluding all specified preferred claims from that cap. Section 7(a) already provides a mutual consequential-damages exclusion. The principal omission is an express statement that Customer payment obligations are not damages and therefore are not capped. Also, “amounts paid or payable between the Parties” is broader and less precise than “fees paid or payable,” and the margin comment inaccurately suggests all added carve-outs were already in Section 7(a). These issues do not prevent compliance with the fallback.
